name: a2amesh-workspace
author: oaslananka
description: A2A Mesh TypeScript infrastructure for A2A-native agent systems.

scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:code && pnpm run lint:md && pnpm run lint:yaml && pnpm run lint:identity
scripts.lint:identity: node scripts/check-package-names.mjs && node scripts/check-workspace-bin-contract.mjs && node scripts/check-identity.mjs && node scripts/check-forbidden-refs.mjs && node scripts/check-no-generated-artifacts.mjs && node scripts/check-no-secrets.mjs && node scripts/check-issue-template-packages.mjs && node scripts/check-runtime-versions.mjs && node scripts/check-labels.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck:no-build
scripts.typecheck:no-build: pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck && pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && pnpm exec tsc -p apps/demo/tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm exec tsc -p apps/registry-ui/tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm exec tsc -p apps/mission-control/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: pnpm run build && pnpm run test:unit:no-build
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run build && pnpm run test:integration:no-build
scripts.test:conformance: pnpm run build && pnpm run test:conformance:no-build
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm run build && pnpm run test:coverage:no-build
scripts.perf:smoke: pnpm run build && pnpm run perf:smoke:no-build
scripts.perf:load: pnpm run build && pnpm run perf:load:no-build
scripts.docs:generate: node scripts/generate-api-docs.mjs && pnpm run docs:commands:generate && pnpm run openapi:generate
scripts.docs:check: pnpm --filter @a2amesh/registry run build && pnpm run docs:check:no-build
scripts.examples:smoke: pnpm run build && pnpm run examples:smoke:no-build
scripts.schemas:generate: pnpm --filter @a2amesh/runtime run build && pnpm run schemas:generate:no-build
scripts.schemas:check: pnpm --filter @a2amesh/runtime run build && pnpm run schemas:check:no-build
scripts.openapi:generate: pnpm --filter @a2amesh/registry run build && pnpm run openapi:generate:no-build
scripts.openapi:check: pnpm --filter @a2amesh/registry run build && pnpm run openapi:check:no-build
scripts.security: pnpm audit --audit-level high && node scripts/run-gitleaks.mjs && node scripts/check-reuse.mjs
scripts.verify:structure: node scripts/check-workspace-graph.mjs && node scripts/check-workspace-declarations.mjs && node scripts/check-public-surface.mjs && node scripts/check-command-surface.mjs && node scripts/check-release-config.mjs && node scripts/check-api-surfaces.mjs && node scripts/check-renovate-config.mjs && node scripts/check-codecov-config.mjs && node scripts/sync-security-policy.mjs --check && node scripts/check-security-tooling.mjs && node scripts/check-coverage-policy.mjs && pnpm run agent:plugin:check
scripts.gc: knip && node scripts/check-duplicates.mjs && node scripts/check-no-generated-artifacts.mjs && node scripts/check-docs-package-parity.mjs && node scripts/check-docs-commands.mjs && node scripts/check-public-surface.mjs && node scripts/check-release-config.mjs && node scripts/check-codecov-config.mjs && node scripts/check-security-tooling.mjs && node scripts/check-coverage-policy.mjs && pnpm run ci:required-summary:check
scripts.ui:install:browsers: pnpm --dir apps/registry-ui exec playwright install --with-deps chromium
scripts.release:ready: pnpm --filter @a2amesh/cli run build && node packages/cli/bin/a2amesh.js release-check
scripts.release:stable-ready: pnpm --filter @a2amesh/cli run build && node packages/cli/bin/a2amesh.js release-check --stable
scripts.ops:check: node scripts/check-ops-pack.mjs && node scripts/check-recovery-operations.mjs && pnpm run containers:check
scripts.test:coverage:ci: pnpm run build && pnpm run test:coverage:ci:no-build
scripts.build:clean: pnpm run clean:build && pnpm run build
scripts.test:integration:no-build: vitest run --project integration --project transport-contract && pnpm run examples:smoke:no-build
scripts.docs:check:no-build: node scripts/check-docs-commands.mjs && node scripts/check-doc-current-state.mjs && node scripts/check-docs-package-parity.mjs && node scripts/check-architecture-docs.mjs && node scripts/check-adrs.mjs && node scripts/check-compatibility-docs.mjs && node scripts/check-powershell-doc-parity.mjs && pnpm run repository:evidence:check && pnpm run openapi:check:no-build
scripts.verify:changed: git diff --check origin/main...HEAD && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck:no-build && pnpm run test:unit:changed
